run_vision_rerank_client: run the vLLM multimodal rerank API client with configurable host and port arguments
parse_rerank_cli_args: parse command line arguments for the rerank client including host and port options
test_rerank_string_documents: test the rerank API with a string query and list of string documents
test_rerank_multimodal_documents: test the rerank API with text, image URL, image base64, and video URL documents
test_rerank_mixed_documents: test the rerank API with mixed text and image documents in a single request
